purpose: The parent's test list (about 15 minutes) to go through after each new version: a checklist per area.
details: Sections: start and child, menus, one exercise per domain (with exact keys), Taal and Werkwoordspelling, series/repeat/points, avatar and shop, parent area, special modes (colour-blind, ASCII), stopping and coming back, and what to do if something is wrong (--fouten). The father works through it on a copy of the data; remarks go to feedback.txt.
summary: Checklist for the parent after each release: start and choose a child, menus, one exercise per maths domain, Taal and verb spelling, series and repeat bin, avatar/shop, parent area, special display modes, stopping with Esc, and how to report problems.
